item.title: Ago Bay: Pearl Rafts and Island-Dotted Waters — Guide
item.description: Ago Bay is the scenic heart of the Ise-Shima region, a deeply indented ria coastline where the sea reaches inland among dozens of forested islets and countless rafts of cultivated pearl oysters, forming one of Japan’s most beautiful and productive stretches of water. This is the cradle of the pearl industry Mikimoto founded, and the classic way to appreciate it is from the water — sightseeing boats, some styled as Spanish galleons, and glass-bottom cruises glide among the islands and pearl rafts, revealing the oyster culture below.
